Lesson 1-1 · Estimation

Objective (from the book, p. 12): It estimates the results of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
The book pages below are interactive. Tap the 💡 for an explanation, type or tap your answers right on the page, and tap 👁 for a step-by-step hint: every tap shows the next step, and after the last step one more tap hides them.
Correct / solution Wrong Suggested (depends on how you round)

Summary

  • I can use rounding to estimate the totals.
  • Underestimation: the estimated result is smaller than the exact value.
  • Overestimation: the estimated result is greater than the exact value.
  • Rounding rules: choose the place value, look at the digit to its right; if it is less than 5 keep the digit the same, if it is 5 or more increase the digit.
  • I can use the symbol ≈ to show an approximate answer.
